basic_profile.bio: I'm a digital nomad currently based in Japan. I work as a freelance software developer, which gives me the flexibility to travel and explore new places. I'm a huge fan of indie games, especially platformers like Ori and the Blind Forest. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy learning about different cultures and trying out local cuisines. I'm usually online during late evenings and nights, especially on weekdays. I'm single and enjoy my independence.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working in software development for over five years. I specialize in web development using Blazor and have a knack for picking up new technologies quickly. My interest in gaming led me to develop a strong understanding of hardware requirements and performance optimization.
